inputs.label: Fate of the Galaxy (Knossos.NET install)
inputs.help: The free Fate of the Galaxy mod, installed on the PC with Knossos.NET. Pick its FotG_R-<version> folder. FreeSpace 2 is not needed.

preparedWith.help: Install Fate of the Galaxy with Knossos.NET. It downloads the free data (2.6 GB) into a FotG_R-<version> folder.

steps.why: The game reads its data from /sdcard/FotG. The guide has the user allow access to all files on the first start.

steps.text: Open Fate of the Galaxy VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for access to all files, allow it.

notes: The guide installs with adb install -r -g, hence grantAll. The guide names folders, not files, inside data (tables, models, maps), so detect lists folders; replace them with real file names once known. The guide's other route, get_fotg_data.py --push from the FotG-VR repository, downloads from the Nebula server and pushes by itself; qgp does not model it. Releases are all pre-releases. About 9 GB is needed on the headset.
